name: coopplatformer-scenery

webgpu.note: the picture at frame 60 at the start of the meadow, GL vs WebGPU within the same bounds as the 2p gate

note: no floating scenery: every prop that stands on the ground is measured against the ground as drawn. g.scenery_off is the number whose base is more than 3 cm above or below the lowest ground under it or that overhang a ledge or the edge of the backdrop. The control lifts the first meadow tree 0.5 m (COOP_FLOAT_BUG, native): it must differ. Every level is swept by coopplatformer-levels.

name: coopplatformer-fire

webgpu.note: the picture at frame 60 at the start of the meadow, GL vs WebGPU within the same bounds as the scenery gate

note: no floating fire: every flame (one emitter per brazier in the caves and ruins) is checked each frame against the basket of a brazier that the scenery check seated on the floor (within 6 cm). g.flames is [flames, flames not in a seated brazier]. Lava lights and ability crystals carry no flame. The control (COOP_FLOAT_FIRE, native) puts each flame where the old torch flames burned, 1.5 m in front of the playfield at the light: its g.flames must differ.

name: coopplatformer-surfaces
note: no plain surfaces and no seam rails: g.surface is [moving platforms, wooden ledges and cracked blocks built with a real PBR material, the same built with a plain colour, seam strips drawn across rock faces]. The control (COOP_PLAIN_BUG, native) brings back the olive platform and the grey seams: its g.surface must differ. Native only: carts have no environment. g.uvrep: percent of sampled wall corners whose texture phase comes back one 4 m repeat on (100 before the uvs wandered; the same control). Re-pinned 45 to 4: this first level has only 4 built surfaces of that kind (the old level held the whole game); the same check runs on the level that is loaded.

name: coopplatformer-pit-camera
note: the camera never looks under the world: two bots start in the ruins spike pit (floor at y 1, the deepest place in the level) and fight their way out. g.underview is [frames drawn, frames whose view reached below the world floor row]; the camera target is held so the bottom edge of the view stays above y 0 (a player at the pit floor stays inside the bottom of the frame). The control (COOP_PIT_CAM_BUG, native) lets the camera follow down: its g.underview must differ. Native only: carts have no environment.

name: coopplatformer-rescue-tags
note: the RESCUE tags of players carried in bubbles never run into each other: three of four players are held in bubbles (COOP_TEST_BUBBLES, native). g.tags is [frames with two or more tags, frames where a tag starts before the word of the tag beside it ends (measured with the font)]. The control (COOP_HUD_BUG, native) brings back the old fixed 90 px step: its g.tags must differ. Native only: carts have no environment. g.marker_over counts markers drawn over the player panels: one bubble is held off the top of the view; the same control brings back the old clamp.

name: coopplatformer-blink
note: the blink after a respawn never hides the whole group: two bots start invulnerable and g.vanish counts frames in which every player on the field was blinked out (only markers left on screen). The control (COOP_BLINK_BUG, native) brings back the 2-tick phase offset: its g.vanish must differ. Native only: carts have no environment.

No shake (2026-10-29): the drawn camera stays smooth through the whole fight, the boss leaps, hits and its death included (g.camgate: 1498 frames in motion, none over the bounds; before, 160 of them shook and were let off), and g.camoffset holds the drawn camera against the follow camera on the 440 frames within half a second of the 19 impacts (none off by over 0.1 mm; the build before, the same 440 frames: 152 off, up to 23 cm). name: coopplatformer-coins

webgpu.note: the picture at frame 60 at the start of the meadow, GL vs WebGPU within the same bounds as the scenery gate

note: every coin stands up: g.coinface is [coins, coins whose disc axis is not level]. Each coin spins about its upright axis through its node and its disc is stood up by its mesh; a coin whose axis has any part along world up lies flat like a plate, edge on to the camera for ever. The control (COOP_COIN_FLAT_BUG, native) leaves the coins flat as they were: its g.coinface must differ.

name: coopplatformer-reach
note: from real movement, every coin, pedestal, flag, cracked wall and room of every level can be reached and no coin sits in rock (reach.c). Control: the levels as they were (COOP_REACH_OLD) must fail.

name: coopplatformer-jump-standing

webgpu.note: the same frame on both backends

note: the standing jump, held input on the real game, from a standstill with the stick and jump pressed together. g.jump is [distance, rise, speed at takeoff]: the short one the running gate is measured against.

name: coopplatformer-jump-running

webgpu.note: the same frame on both backends

note: West (X) held: speed builds to its top in a second and the jump from it goes about twice as far and a metre and a quarter higher than the standing one. The control is the same input with West let go (a walk and a jump): its g.jump must differ.

name: coopplatformer-music-file
note: every track decodes in a second, independent player, runs its form with no silence or clipping, and its restart is not a click. Control: a track with no notes.

name: coopplatformer-levels
note: every level finished by bots with 1, 2 and 4 players, and every level grounded. Controls: bots that never hold Run do not finish the first level; a lifted tree shows.

name: coopplatformer-touch

webgpu.note: the same frame on both backends
